name: Nokian Renkaat Oyj
reason: Tyre maker whose EBIT margin collapsed from 23.3% (2018) to 2.6% after the forced Russia exit and US/Romania plant build, with adj EPS EUR 2.14 to -0.11 and net debt/EBITDA 3.73x; turnaround in a competitive commodity-input industry, not a forecastable compounder.

name: Vidrala SA
reason: Iberian/UK glass-container oligopolist with 10y adj EPS CAGR 14.1% (EUR 1.65 to 6.16) but EBIT margin at a 100th-pctile 20.7% vs 15.3% avg after energy-driven glass price inflation, 2025 EPS -19.7% and consensus only +5.7%/+7.0%; normalised growth is hard to call.

name: Dom Development SA
reason: Warsaw homebuilder at a housing-cycle peak (EPS PLN 3.25 to 25.36, EBIT margin 24.8% at the 100th pctile) with consensus FY1 +4.0% and LTG 1%; earnings set by the Polish housing and mortgage-rate cycle (US precedent: homebuilders out).

name: Granges AB
reason: Aluminium rolled-products maker with EBIT margin down from 11.9% to 5.5%, ROIC 8.8%, and growth bought via acquisitions at 1.65x 10y FCF plus 2.4%/yr share dilution; metal-spread and auto/HVAC cyclical earnings without specialness.

name: Pharming Group NV
reason: Rare-disease biotech dependent on Ruconest and Joenja with adj EPS of USD ~0.00 to 0.06 for a decade (2023 -179%), 10y ROIC -5.9% and NTM P/E 43x; single-product regulatory/competitive risk makes it unforecastable and fails the earnings-record test.

name: Vetoquinol SA
reason: Mid-size animal-health company with net cash and EUR adj EPS 2.04 to 5.22 (10y CAGR 9.9% flattered by a 2020 trough), but revenue CAGR only 4.4%, ROIC 9.8% and consensus +4.0%/+6.6%/+6.3% give no clear route to >=7% versus larger rivals.

name: Telecom Plus Plc
reason: Utility Warehouse energy/telecom reseller whose 10y adj EPS CAGR of 7.9% (GBP 0.56 to 1.21) came mainly from the 2022 energy-price shock, with margins at the 91st pctile and consensus FY1 -31.8%; earnings depend on Ofgem price-cap rules and wholesale energy, so cannot be forecast with confidence.

name: Danone SA
reason: Global dairy/water/nutrition brand owner with 10y adj EPS CAGR only 2.7% (EUR 2.92 to 3.80), 2/10 years >=7%, ROIC 6.2% and a 71% adj-vs-GAAP gap from repeated write-downs; good franchise but no plausible >=7% EPS route.

name: Hammerson Plc
reason: UK/Irish shopping-centre REIT with EPS falling from GBP 4.23 (2015) to losses through 2018-24, 11.4%/yr share dilution from the rights issue and net debt/EBITDA 14.8x; structurally challenged retail property with a balance sheet that failed the last downturn.

name: Koncar-Distributivni I Specijalni Transformatori dd
reason: Croatian transformer maker riding the grid-capex boom: EUR EPS 12.41 (2019) to 275.89 (2025) with EBIT margin 33.3% at the 100th pctile vs a 12.5% 10y avg; earnings at a cyclical/order-book peak with no consensus coverage and a parent-controlled float.

name: Henkel AG & Co. KGaA
reason: Adhesives and consumer-brands conglomerate with 10y adj EPS CAGR 1.1% (EUR 4.77 to 5.33), ROIC 9.3% and consensus +2.4%/+5.9%/+6.9%; adhesives is a good business but the record and outlook give no >=7% route.

name: Dunelm Group plc
reason: UK homewares retailer with high ROIC (32.8%) but 10y adj EPS CAGR only 4.3% (GBP 0.50 to 0.77, flat since 2022) and consensus +0.5%/+4.7%/+5.5%; mature single-country discretionary retailer without a >=7% growth route.

name: Azelis Group NV
reason: Specialty-chemicals distributor built by acquisitions (spend 2.64x 10y FCF) with net debt/EBITDA 3.83x, ROIC 3.6% and 2025 GAAP EPS -38.5% (EUR 0.46 vs 0.91 peak); growth from acquisitions and leverage fails the test.

name: IONOS Group SE
reason: Europe's largest SMB web-hosting/domain provider with sticky subscription revenue, EBIT margin 20-26% throughout, GAAP EPS EUR 0.34 (2018) to 1.63 (5y CAGR 24.8%), recurring FCF (conversion 1.26x), net debt 1.96x and consensus +12%/+25%/+17%; test AI site-builder/hyperscaler threat and United Internet control in deep dive.

name: Big Yellow Group Plc
reason: High-quality London/SE self-storage REIT, but FFO/sh has stalled (GBP 0.74 in FY2019 vs 0.60 in FY2025), shares grow 2.3%/yr and consensus +3.4%/+4.8%; forecastable but no >=7% earnings route.

name: Morgan Sindall Group plc
reason: UK contractor/partnership-housing group with EPS GBP 0.63 to 3.53 but EBIT margin 4.4% at the 100th pctile of a 2.8% average and consensus FY2 -5.3%; thin-margin construction earnings at a cyclical high driven by public-sector spend.

name: Dätwyler Holding AG
reason: Elastomer components maker with attractive pharma-seal niche but 10y adj EPS CAGR -0.6% (CHF 5.04 to 4.73), large write-downs in 2019-20, acquisitions at 1.32x 10y FCF and net debt 2.0x; record shows no compounding and growth relies on M&A.

name: Embla Medical hf
reason: Össur prosthetics/bracing franchise with a durable niche and consensus +20.7%/+14.5%/+13.3%, but 10y adj EPS CAGR only 4.4% (USD 0.13 to 0.20), ROIC 6.6%, acquisitions at 0.68x FCF and net debt 2.4x; acquisition-led growth and US reimbursement make the path hard to forecast.

name: Friedrich Vorwerk Group SE
reason: German pipeline/grid contractor with EPS EUR 0.51 (2023) to 4.33 (2025) on the energy-transition build-out, EBIT margin 15.5% at the 100th pctile vs 9.0% avg and consensus +4.5%/+2.8% after FY1; project earnings at a cyclical peak.

name: 4iG Nyrt.
reason: Debt-funded Hungarian telecom/IT/defence roll-up with acquisitions 4.45x FCF, 11.9%/yr share dilution, losses in 2022-25 (HUF EPS -18.44 in 2025) and net debt 3.1x, plus politically connected ownership; fails acquisition, leverage and governance tests.
